title: Nanyue King Museum
scope: The red-sandstone Nanyue Palace Garden Hall at the Zhongshan Fourth Road entrance to the Palace and Garden exhibition site, at the east end of the Guangzhou palace precinct.
limitations: The road-front Palace Garden Hall is represented. The institution’s tomb branch, separate archaeological exhibition halls, staged plaza events and unverified interior rooms remain outside scope.
The named full footprint and older east building outline govern width and orientation. The height, rear elevation and roof terrace subdivision use visual or documented proportion estimates.
